headline.purpose: Dialog, sheet and alert-dialog titles (font-heading, text-lg, semibold, tight).

title.purpose: type-column-title: column titles, strips, the create-list tile. Uppercase; size set at the call site (text-lg on a column, text-sm on a strip).

body.purpose: To-do titles and board text (text-sm, leading-snug).

eyebrow.purpose: type-eyebrow: subtitles, group headers, timeline day labels. Uppercase, muted.

numeric.purpose: num utility: a number that stands alone (a date, a count, a time). Tabular, slashed zero, lining.

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Today's card, a raised tab pill.

shadows.name: shadow-card-dark
shadows.purpose: Dark theme: same role; the inset hairline says the edge is nearer.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Hover, fill, color. The hover wash arrives on this.

motion.name: dur-base
motion.purpose: The strike, the check flash, a card scaling in, every backdrop fade; the hover wash leaves on this.

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: A drop settling. The arrival budget: nothing arrives slower.

motion.name: dur-travel
motion.purpose: Paired only with ease-spring-travel; the curve is sampled across exactly this span. Arrival is still inside dur-slow.

motion.name: dur-overlay
motion.purpose: Paired only with ease-spring-overlay; ~95% arrived at 137ms.

motion.name: dur-sheet
motion.purpose: A sheet crossing its own width (globals.css; not yet in docs/DESIGN.md §4).

motion.name: dur-overlay-exit
motion.purpose: Overlay exits: shorter than entry, unsprung, on ease-out-soft.

motion.name: ease-out-soft
motion.purpose: Anything that lands; every edge-anchored surface; the reduced-motion replacement for a spring.

motion.name: ease-spring-travel
motion.purpose: Something that travels between two places (the tab highlight). transform only; 4.9% overshoot.

motion.name: ease-spring-overlay
motion.purpose: A centered dialog scaling in place. transform only; 1.6% overshoot. Never on a sheet.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink fill, paper text. Used sparingly; the shared focus-ring outline in spectrum solid.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font-family: var(--app-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--dur-fast, 100ms), transform var(--dur-fast, 100ms); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Paper with a hairline border; muted on hover. The everyday secondary action (Close, Undo).
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--app-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--dur-fast, 100ms), transform var(--dur-fast, 100ms); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Transparent until hovered; the board's default for icon and toolbar controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--app-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--dur-fast, 100ms), transform var(--dur-fast, 100ms); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Urgent Badge
components.description: The In Overflow badge: urgent at 10% behind urgent text. The app's only red badge.
components.css: .ds-badge-urgent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-4xl, 26px); background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--urgent) 10%, transparent); color: var(--urgent); font-family: var(--app-sans); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: 32px field, transparent fill, input-colored border; focus moves the border to the spectrum-solid ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 16rem; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius-lg, 10px); background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--app-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; outline: none; transition: border-color var(--dur-fast, 100ms), box-shadow var(--dur-fast, 100ms); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: To-do Row
components.description: Signature row: no border, no fill, a 12px gutter for the square checkbox, an achromatic priority rail (P1 double 5px shown), and an ink-at-5% hover wash in fast, out slower. Done is struck; Won't do only dims.

components.css: .ds-todo-list { width: 15rem; background: var(--background); } .ds-todo { position: relative; display: block; padding: 8px 8px 8px 12px; color: var(--foreground); font-family: var(--app-sans); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.375; transition: background-color var(--dur-base, 180ms) cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-todo:hover, .ds-todo:focus-within { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 5%, transparent); transition-duration: var(--dur-fast, 100ms); } .ds-todo-rail { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-p1 { width: 5px; opacity: 1; background: linear-gradient(to right, var(--foreground) 0 2px, transparent 2px 3px, var(--foreground) 3px); } .ds-p3 { width: 2px; opacity: 0.75; background: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--foreground) 0 6px, transparent 6px 9px); } .ds-todo-box { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 10px; display: inline-grid; place-content: center; width: 16px; height: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--muted-foreground); border-radius: 0; color: var(--primary-foreground); } .ds-todo-box.ds-checked { background: var(--primary); border-color: var(--primary); } .ds-todo-title { display: block; text-indent: 24px; } .ds-done .ds-todo-title { color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: line-through; } .ds-dropped .ds-todo-title { color: var(--muted-foreground); opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Today Column Header
components.description: a type-eyebrow date over type-column-title, on today's card: surface-1, shadow-card, the spectrum hairline, no border.
components.css: .ds-today { width: 12rem; min-height: 6rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md, 8px); background: var(--surface-1); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card); } .ds-col-head { position: relative; padding: 12px 12px 8px; } .ds-col-head::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0 10px auto 10px; height: 2px; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--spectrum); pointer-events: none; } .ds-col-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--app-heading); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-eyebrow { margin: 0; font-family: var(--app-sans); font-size: 0.625rem; line-height: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--muted-foreground); }

narrative.overview:
The brief (docs/DESIGN.md, 2026-09-03): Notion's utility, MyMind's calm design and whimsy, the reliability of a Casio F-91W. Snappy and native. The board is an achromatic instrument: white paper, near-black ink, and color only where a color has a job. The hand-drawn cursive F stays black and white; the app's one pop of color is a low-chroma spectrum, used the way the Dia mark uses it. Nothing on the board reads as generic shadcn.

Density comes from structure, not decoration. Columns are air, today is the one card, priority is a mark rather than a chip, and every color answers "what does this mean?" with exactly one channel (docs/DESIGN.md §1). Motion is short and lands: a thing is where it belongs inside 260ms, and the state is correct with the motion removed (§4).
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic base (`oklch(L 0 0)` everywhere except the named channels).
One color meaning per channel; a new element takes an existing channel or stays achromatic.
The spectrum as a hairline and a flash in four places, never area.
Serif headings over a humanist sans (Editorial pairing); tabular numerals in mono.
Whitespace separates columns; no borders, no dividers.

rules.name: The Arrival Budget Rule
rules.body: Arrival is under 260ms (`--dur-slow`). A spring's settle tail may run to ~400ms, on `transform` only. Confetti is the one exception, and opt-in. Scroll-driven motion on `/` is exempt because it has no duration (docs/DESIGN.md §4, §6).

rules.name: The Motion-Removed Rule
rules.body: Every animation carries `motion-reduce:animate-none`, and the state it announces must be correct without it. Reduced motion drops the overshoot, not just the animation: swap the spring for `--ease-out-soft` or `transition-none`. An animation keys on a transition, never on a state (docs/DESIGN.md §4).

rules.name: The One Channel Rule
rules.body: Every color on the board belongs to exactly one channel, and a channel means one thing. If a new element needs color, it takes the channel that already means that thing, or it stays achromatic (docs/DESIGN.md §1).

rules.name: The Four Places Rule
rules.body: The spectrum appears in four places only: the F mark on hover and focus, the today column's top hairline, the checked-box flash, and the focus ring. Never a fill, a text color, a badge, or a fifth place. It changes color, not position (docs/DESIGN.md §1, §7 decision B).

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red means urgent, only. Users may pick Tomato for a list; the app itself adds no second red anywhere (docs/DESIGN.md §1, §7 decision A).

rules.name: The Form Not Hue Rule
rules.body: Priority is carried by the rail's thickness, line style and opacity, never by hue: P1 double 5px, P2 solid 3px, P3 dashed 2px, P4 dotted 2px, all `--foreground` at falling opacity (`PRIORITY_RAILS` in `src/lib/priority.ts`; docs/DESIGN.md §1, §7 decision A and 2026-09-10).

rules.name: The Strike Means Done Rule
rules.body: `done` gets a strike-through; Won't do (`dropped`) only dims (`opacity-70`) and never gets the strike, because a strike says "this got done" (docs/DESIGN.md §1).

rules.name: The No New Brand Rule
rules.body: The marketing site reuses the app's tokens and invents nothing: no brand color beyond the spectrum (and the spectrum in one place per page at most), no hero gradient that covers area, no third font family (docs/DESIGN.md §6).

rules.name: The Hue Rides Edges Rule
rules.body: Identity hue goes on borders and fills, never on text, because a step-9 hue at `text-2xs` fails contrast in one theme or the other. Label chips are the one exception: hue text on a tint of the same hue. Never on a card body (docs/DESIGN.md §1).

rules.name: The Roles Not Families Rule
rules.body: Components reference type roles (`font-sans`, `font-heading`, `font-mono`, `num`, `nums`, `type-column-title`, `type-eyebrow`), never families, so a pairing switch reaches every component (docs/DESIGN.md §2).

rules.name: The Columns Are Air Rule
rules.body: No column borders or backgrounds. Whitespace (12px `gap-3`) is the only column separator, and rows have no dividers: separation is spacing (36px rhythm, `py-2`) and the hover wash. Overflow and Backlog are the two exceptions, carrying `bg-surface-0` so their resize edges register (docs/DESIGN.md §3, §7 2026-09-05).

rules.name: The Only Card Rule
rules.body: Today is the board's only card: `--surface-1` + `shadow-card` + the spectrum hairline, and no border; the shadow carries the edge (docs/DESIGN.md §3).

rules.name: The Ink-at-5% Rule
rules.body: Hover and focus-within on a row or group header is `bg-foreground/5`: it darkens in light, lifts in dark, and still composites over a 5% identity wash (docs/DESIGN.md §3).

dos: **Do** take the channel that already means the thing, or stay achromatic (docs/DESIGN.md §1).
**Do** use `bg-foreground/5` for row and group-header hover and focus-within (§3).
**Do** give every button the shared `focus-ring` utility (§3).
**Do** put springs on `transform` only; anything that tints, fades or reflows takes a fixed duration (§4).
**Do** prefer a color or opacity change to a layout change, and `transform` to anything that reflows (§4).
**Do** read docs/DRAG-AND-DROP.md §6 and TODO-ITEM-DESIGN.md §10 before touching a row (§5).
**Do** express every new decision as a token or a named rule, so the upcoming SwiftUI app can port it.
donts: **Don't** add a second red anywhere in the app (§1).
**Don't** use the spectrum as a fill, a text color, a badge, or in a fifth place (§1).
**Don't** give priority a hue (§1, §7 decision A).
**Don't** put identity hue on `text-2xs` text or a card body (§1).
**Don't** use status colors on board content (§1).
**Don't** give a column a border or background, or divide rows with rules; Overflow and Backlog's `surface-0` is the only exception (§3).
**Don't** add streaks, counters, or progress gamification (§4; docs/RESEARCH.md §2.9, §4).
**Don't** add a brand color beyond the spectrum, a hero gradient that covers area, or a third font family on the marketing site (§6).
